name: player
_comment: Slot -> clip (clips.json names, one FBX per clip in assets/human). Missing clips (docs/ANIMATION.md 'Missing clips') play idle: unbound base-layer states fall back to it, upper-body states stay procedural. idle_{weapon} / run_f_{weapon} / sprint_{weapon}: unlisted weapon types use idle / run_f / sprint. The long guns sprint with Sprint Forward (the rifle sprint): it carries the gun, both hands on it (controller "carry"). Jumps: one clip split at its take-off / touchdown (bake_anim --survey, anim_probe) into start (rising), air (held), land. Modifiers: @reverse, @mirror, @a:b (normalized sub-range).
